Hi Alex — great questions. Short answers up front, followed by options:  

- Yes, we can route per-endpoint by policy so you can run Compact for steady traffic and route to Elastic for bursts (automatic fallback possible).
- You can start the pilot with Lite NLU and upgrade to Clinical NLU later without re-provisioning; the upgrade is a model/feature flag change and can be rolled out via canary.
- We can provide a limited pilot credit; I outlined two commercial options below.

Options (recommended order):

A) Conservative pilot — minimal change
- Keep current endpoints but add a routing rule: Compact primary, Elastic fallback for 99th-percentile bursts.
- Swap to Lite NLU for initial 30 days, keep Clinical NLU as a feature toggle.
- Commercial: 10% off list pricing for month 1 + a $20k pilot credit (applies to token usage).

B) Aggressive cost-first pilot — more risk, lower cost
- Move 60% steady traffic to Compact at route level, run Elastic only for scheduled peak windows.
- Pilot credit: $25k + 15% off month 1 if commit to a 6-month Dedicated capacity evaluation.

C) Technical-first — full feature fidelity
- Keep Elastic for all traffic, enable Clinical NLU; use caching and batching to control cost.
- No pilot credit; suggest joint eval and optimization workshop.

I attached a short pricing proposal with the two commercial variants and the expected unit economics by token band. If you want, we can do a 30-minute call Monday to agree which option to put in a short amendment.

Attachments: novuscare_pricing_proposal_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
